customer: hi, so i got maried last year and my drivers license has my new last name now but the title on my convertable still has my maiden name. im a nurse on night shifts so i really dont want to show up to the apointment and get turned away, what do i need to bring? this is in Dunmore if that matters
agent: Congratulations, and thanks for checking ahead! Per our article "The name on the title doesn't match my ID," please bring the document that shows your name change, which in your case is your marriage certificate. At the appointment you'll also sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1. If you notice your maiden name is actually misspelled on the title, ask your state's motor vehicle agency to correct that first.
